claims.claim: Policy allows project resources after a true trust decision.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:453 awaits resolveProjectTrust and applies its boolean via setProjectTrusted, so a true decision makes the post-bootstrap packageManager.resolve() include project extensions.

claims.claim: Policy denies project resources after a false trust decision.
claims.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:453-454 propagate the resolver's false result; the reload path then resolves only user/CLI extensions.

claims.claim: The resolver must observe an untrusted bootstrap result.
claims.evidence: loadProjectTrustExtensions() forces setProjectTrusted(false) and reloads settings before loadCurrentExtensionSet(), and that bootstrap LoadExtensionsResult is the object passed to resolveProjectTrust.
claims.verified_by: .prale-eval/regression.mjs scenarios 1 and 2 (resolver sees cli.ts + user.ts only, settingsLoadedTrust === false)

claims.claim: The resolver is called exactly once and its asynchronous ordering is preserved.
claims.evidence: Single awaited call site in reload(); setProjectTrusted runs only after the promise settles, followed by settingsManager.reload() and the trusted resolve.
claims.verified_by: .prale-eval/regression.mjs scenario 1 (call count === 1; no set/resolve/settings true events before the resolver returns; set->settings->resolve ordering after it)

claims.claim: Reload without a resolver still honors the caller-provided trust state.
claims.evidence: reload() only consults a resolver when options.resolveProjectTrust is supplied; otherwise preTrustExtensions stays undefined and no trust is forced.

changes: packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts: replaced the hardcoded `const projectTrusted = false;` with `const projectTrusted = await options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions });` so the trust resolver is consulted exactly once with the untrusted bootstrap extension result and its decision is applied only after the promise settles. No other source changes.

validation.notes: Regression replayed against the repaired source: exits 0 with all assertions holding (resolver call count exactly 1; resolver observes bootstrap extensions cli.ts+user.ts with project.ts excluded and settingsLoadedTrust false; no set/resolve/settings-true event occurs before the delayed resolver settles, proving the decision is not applied early; set(true) -> settings(true) -> resolve(true) order after it; project.ts loaded after true, excluded after false, and control scenario without a resolver keeps caller-provided trust). The same script was replayed against a temporary copy of the original fault (`const projectTrusted = false;`) and failed with AssertionError ERR_ASSERTION "reload() with a resolveProjectTrust callback must consult the trust resolver exactly once" (0 !== 1) at regression.mjs:42, exit 1, confirming it detects this stage's fault without timing out or hitting a syntax/import error. The modified source also parses under Node 24 type stripping. Limitation: the repository's vitest suites (e.g. packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts) could not be run because no node_modules are installed and installing dependencies was out of scope, so only the standalone VM-module regression was executed.
